description: A Codex pane ORCHESTRATING a Claude Code pane: its transcript is full of `tmux send-keys` / `capture-pane` output, so Claude Code's chrome ("auto mode on (shift+tab to cycle)", "session: … ctx · $2.10", "history: N prompts · N tools") appears in its CONTENT. The phone intermittently filed this pane as tool=claude while still reporting model='gpt-6-astra medium' — a self-contradicting row, since Claude Code never runs a gpt- model. The captured Claude chrome is quoted output, not this pane's own UI; the pane's OWN bottom line names an OpenAI model and its input box reads "Ask Codex to do anything". Guards the rule that an OpenAI model name in the pane's own status bar settles the tool, and that agent chrome appearing inside captured output is content. Takes no position on `session`.
